description: This file defines a Vue store named 'products' that manages product data, categories, and related actions in an e-commerce frontend application. It includes state variables, computed properties for featured and new products, and asynchronous functions to load data from an API.

methods.name: loadCategories
methods.description: Fetches all product categories from the backend API and updates the store state.

methods.name: loadProducts
methods.description: Fetches products, optionally filtered by a category slug, and updates the store state.

methods.name: loadProduct
methods.description: Fetches a single product by ID from the backend API and updates the currentProduct state.
